test: P1376 (capital of) a sovereign state, no end time (current capital); Rome, Cairo, Amman
rationale: A current capital of a sovereign state

test: former capital: P1376 with an end time, or class former capital, of an empire or sovereign state
rationale: A former seat of an empire or sovereign state; sub-state seats do not count

test: class beach, fjord, reef, lagoon, coast, cape, bay, gulf, peninsula, atoll, archipelago or island (kind_classes.csv R03)
rationale: A beach, scenic coast, island, reef or lagoon

test: the pin within 2 km of the Natural Earth coastline (a stand-in for the OSM beach rule R04 until S3d)
rationale: The sea is the setting

test: centroid within 1 km of the coastline and an OSM natural=beach of 500 m or more within 5 km [needs OSM, S3d: not evaluated yet]
rationale: Coastline plus a mapped beach

test: class port, harbour, port city or lighthouse, and the pin within 3 km of the coastline
rationale: A port or harbour city

test: a settlement of 100,000 inhabitants or more within 3 km of the coastline (a stand-in for the OSM harbour rule R06 until S3d)
rationale: A coastal city of that size is a port

test: harbour=* or landuse=port or man_made=lighthouse within 3 km, and a quay or pier of 1 km or more [needs OSM, S3d: not evaluated yet]
rationale: Mapped harbour infrastructure

test: P31/P279* in {ruins Q109607, archaeological site Q839954, ancient city}
rationale: A civilisation no longer living there

test: historic=ruins or historic=archaeological_site [needs OSM, S3d: not evaluated yet]
rationale: Mapped ruins

test: cultural criterion iii or iv, inception before 1500, no continuing urban fabric [needs the UNESCO criteria, not ingested: not evaluated yet]
rationale: UNESCO cultural value of a vanished civilisation

test: P31/P279* in {place of worship Q1370598, pilgrimage site}
rationale: A place of worship or pilgrimage

test: criterion vi with a religious association [needs the UNESCO criteria, not ingested: not evaluated yet]
rationale: Outstanding religious association

test: WDPA category Ia, Ib, II or IV and the place IS that protected area (its WDPA id); polygon overlap needs the WDPA polygons
rationale: The place is or is mostly a protected area; a city beside a park is not wildlife

test: class national park, nature reserve, biosphere reserve or protected area on the place itself (kind_classes.csv R12b)
rationale: A national park or reserve by class; the IUCN category (R12) raises it when WDPA is present

test: ESA WorldCover bare or sparse over 60 % of a 20 km buffer (the aridity index is not used yet: no open aridity raster is ingested)
rationale: Desert and dry plains

test: class desert, oasis, depression, erg or dune (kind_classes.csv R13b)
rationale: A desert landform named by Wikidata

test: relief of 1000 m or more within 10 km, or a summit of 2500 m or more in the footprint
rationale: A mountain landscape

test: class mountain, mountain range, massif, pass, summit, hill or ski resort (kind_classes.csv R14b)
rationale: A mountain feature named by Wikidata

test: P31/P279* in {volcano, volcanic field, geyser field}, part of the place itself
rationale: A volcano or geothermal field is part of it

test: population 1,000,000 or more, or a 300 km2 urban area (GHSL)
rationale: A big modern city

test: a whole World Heritage property whose UNESCO title names a historic centre, old town, medina, walled city or historic city, held by a settlement (the title is the UNESCO asset's text; the place's own name is never read)
rationale: Protected living urban fabric

test: class old town (Q676050) on the place or an identity-merged item, and it is a settlement
rationale: Protected or recognised historic urban fabric named by Wikidata

test: freshwater lake, river, delta, wetland or waterfall of 5 km2 or more is the destination or its main setting
rationale: Lakes, rivers and waterfalls

test: water and wetland over 15 % of a 10 km buffer (WorldCover) and the pin at least 5 km from the sea
rationale: Freshwater is the setting

test: tree cover over 50 % of a 10 km buffer, or a protected forest
rationale: Forest and jungle

test: cropland plus grassland over 60 % of a 10 km buffer (WorldCover), no other place of 50,000 inhabitants within 10 km; density is not used yet
rationale: Countryside and villages

test: fallback: population 100,000 or more, used only when no other kind survives (an ordinary modern city: Lille, Nantes, Murcia, Eskişehir)
rationale: D26: every ordinary city carries a kind
